cw_sr_retire_antarctica = {
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_antarctica_retired } }
set_country_flag = cw_sr_antarctica_retired
clr_country_flag = antarctica_has_active_station
clr_country_flag = antarctica_station_setup_capacity_reserved
clr_country_flag = auto_resupply_antarctica_station
clr_country_flag = antarctica_post_treaty_station_violation
clr_country_flag = antarctica_treaty_join_pending
clr_country_flag = antarctica_atcp_application_pending
set_variable = { var_open_MD_antarctica_gui = 0 }
set_variable = { antarctica_station_total_upkeep_multiplier = 0 }
set_variable = { antarctica_station_setup_in_progress = 0 }
set_variable = { antarctica_station_dismantle_in_progress = 0 }
set_variable = { research_station_module_repair_days_remaining = 0 }
if = { limit = { has_idea = at_member }
remove_ideas = at_member
}
}
if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = antarctica_laboratory_dynamic_modifier }
remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = antarctica_laboratory_dynamic_modifier }
}
}

cw_sr_migrate_weekly = {
if = { limit = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_weekly_finance } }
divide_variable = { cw_sr_budget = 52 }
set_country_flag = cw_sr_weekly_finance
set_variable = { cw_sr_tab = 1 }
}
}

cw_sr_seed_world = {
if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_sr_world_initialized } }
set_global_flag = cw_sr_world_initialized
set_global_flag = cw_sr_first_first_orbital_satellite
set_global_flag = cw_sr_first_first_crewed_spaceflight
set_global_flag = cw_sr_first_first_crewed_lunar_landing
}
}

cw_sr_recount = {
set_variable = { cw_sr_active = 0 }
set_variable = { cw_sr_demand = 0 }
set_variable = { cw_sr_flights = 0 }
set_variable = { cw_sr_weekly_upkeep_m = 0 }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cw_sr_p1_state = 1 } }
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_active = 1 }
}
if = { limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cw_sr_p1_state = 1 } check_variable = { cw_sr_p1_state = 6 } } }
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_demand = 1 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cw_sr_p1_state = 4 } }
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_flights = 1 }
}
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_p1_deployed }
add_to_variable = { cw_sr_weekly_upkeep_m = 46.15385 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cw_sr_p2_state = 1 } }

cw_sr_rank = {
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_score1 = 0 }
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_score2 = 0 }
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_score3 = 0 }
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_ties = 0 }
if = { limit = { has_event_target = cw_sr_rank1 }
clear_global_event_target = cw_sr_rank1
}
if = { limit = { has_event_target = cw_sr_rank2 }
clear_global_event_target = cw_sr_rank2
}
if = { limit = { has_event_target = cw_sr_rank3 }
clear_global_event_target = cw_sr_rank3
}
every_country = { clr_country_flag = cw_sr_ranked if = { limit = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_leader } clr_country_flag = cw_sr_leader } }
every_country = { limit = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized check_variable = { cw_sr_prestige > 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_ranked } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cw_sr_prestige > global.cw_sr_score1 } }
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_score1 = cw_sr_prestige }
save_global_event_target_as = cw_sr_rank1
}
}
if = { limit = { has_event_target = cw_sr_rank1 }
event_target:cw_sr_rank1 = { set_country_flag = cw_sr_ranked }
}
every_country = { limit = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized check_variable = { cw_sr_prestige > 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_ranked } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cw_sr_prestige > global.cw_sr_score2 } }
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_score2 = cw_sr_prestige }
save_global_event_target_as = cw_sr_rank2
}
}
if = { limit = { has_event_target = cw_sr_rank2 }
event_target:cw_sr_rank2 = { set_country_flag = cw_sr_ranked }
}
every_country = { limit = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized check_variable = { cw_sr_prestige > 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = cw_sr_ranked } }
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cw_sr_prestige > global.cw_sr_score3 } }
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_score3 = cw_sr_prestige }
save_global_event_target_as = cw_sr_rank3
}
}
if = { limit = { has_event_target = cw_sr_rank3 }
event_target:cw_sr_rank3 = { set_country_flag = cw_sr_ranked }
}
every_country = { limit = { is_ai = no has_country_flag = cw_sr_initialized check_variable = { cw_sr_prestige > 0 } check_variable = { cw_sr_prestige = global.cw_sr_score1 } } add_to_variable = { global.cw_sr_ties = 1 }
}
if = { limit = { check_variable = { global.cw_sr_ties = 1 } }
event_target:cw_sr_rank1 = { set_country_flag = cw_sr_leader }
}
cw_sr_touch = yes
}

cw_sr_windows = {
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_mars = global.year }
subtract_from_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_mars = 1970 }
multiply_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_mars = 12 }
add_to_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_mars = global.month }
add_to_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_mars = 9 }
modulo_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_mars = 26 }
set_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_venus = global.year }
subtract_from_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_venus = 1970 }
multiply_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_venus = 12 }
add_to_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_venus = global.month }
add_to_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_venus = 11 }
modulo_variable = { global.cw_sr_window_venus = 19 }
}

cw_sr_refresh = {
cw_sr_recount = yes
cw_sr_heritage = yes
if = { limit = { check_variable = { cw_sr_selected = 1 } }
cw_sr_p1_odds = yes
set_variable = { cw_sr_view_progress = cw_sr_p1_work }
set_variable = { cw_sr_view_launch = cw_sr_p1_lp }
set_variable = { cw_sr_view_objective = cw_sr_p1_op }
set_variable = { cw_sr_view_full = cw_sr_p1_fp }
set_variable = { cw_sr_view_state = cw_sr_p1_state }
set_variable = { cw_sr_view_days = cw_sr_p1_days }
set_variable = { cw_sr_view_arrears = cw_sr_p1_arrears }
set_variable = { cw_sr_view_investigation = cw_sr_p1_im }
